entities.name: Network-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to de-register a UE by sending a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message and starting timer T3522.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate de-registration of the UE.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to accept the de-registration request.

entities.name: 5GMM cause IE
entities.description: Information element that specifies the reason for the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: De-registration type IE
entities.description: Information element that indicates whether re-registration is needed or not.

entities.name: Access type
entities.description: Information element that indicates whether de-registration is for 3GPP access, non-3GPP access, or both.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI IE
entities.description: Information element included when UE does not support extended rejected NSSAI.

entities.name: Extended rejected NSSAI IE
entities.description: Information element included when UE supports extended rejected NSSAI.

entities.name: CAG information list IE
entities.description: Information element that may be included for CAG-related de-registration.

entities.name: Extended CAG information list IE
entities.description: Information element that may be included for CAG-related de-registration when UE supports extended CAG information.

entities.name: Disaster return wait range IE
entities.description: Information element that may be included for MINT-related de-registration.

entities.name: Timer T3522
entities.description: Timer started by the network when sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by the AMF after triggering PDU session release.

entities.name: Network slice-specific authentication and authorization failure
entities.description: Condition that triggers de-registration with 5GMM cause #62.

entities.name: CAG restrictions
entities.description: Condition that triggers de-registration with 5GMM cause #76.

entities.name: Network not allowed to operate at UE location
entities.description: Condition that triggers de-registration with 5GMM cause #78.

entities.name: UAS services not allowed
entities.description: Condition that triggers de-registration with 5GMM cause #79.

entities.name: Disaster condition no longer applicable
entities.description: Condition that triggers de-registration with 5GMM cause #11.

entities.name: PDU session release
entities.description: AMF triggers SMF to release PDU sessions over indicated access(es).

relations.description: Procedure initiation step involves sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain 5GMM cause IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains De-registration type IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains Access type IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Rejected NSSAI IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Extended rejected NSSAI IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain CAG information list IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Extended CAG information list IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Disaster return wait range IE.
Procedure starts timer T3522 when sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST.
Receiving DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT stops timer T3522.
Network slice auth failure condition guards 5GMM cause IE value #62.
CAG restrictions condition guards 5GMM cause IE value #76.
Location not allowed condition guards 5GMM cause IE value #78.
UAS services not allowed condition guards 5GMM cause IE value #79.
Disaster condition ended guards 5GMM cause IE value #11.
Procedure establishes PDU session release property.
